captions.detailed: This 3D model features a six-pointed sheriff-style star badge with a flat, uniform thickness. Each point of the star is sharp, and there is a small, detached cylindrical post positioned symmetrically just outside the outer tip of each point. The badge has a flat back and a flat front surface intended for custom embossed text.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable sheriff's star badge with a flat backing. The user should be able to adjust the overall radius of the star, the thickness of the backing, the text size, the text embossing height, and the custom text string to be centered on the badge.
captions.factory: The script uses a custom 'drawTriangle' module that combines a central 3-sided cylinder with three small outer cylinders using a union. A six-pointed star is created in the 'drawStar' module by unioning one triangle with a duplicate rotated 180 degrees, and then subtracting a small rectangular cube from the back to act as a pin channel. Finally, the main assembly uses a union to combine the star with embossed text generated via the 'write' library module, offset vertically based on the thickness and text height parameters.
